title: assay.ledger-lock/1
description: A per-head publish lock's lease (docs/architecture/02-architecture.md §5, 06-operations.md §1, 03-contracts.md §6c): the message of the commit `refs/heads/lock-<repo_id>-<head_sha>` points at, written by the verdict check's writer that takes it (TTL 2 minutes). `run_uid.repo_id` and `head_sha` must be those of the ref's name. It is the whole message of the commit its ref points at, read back strictly: a message over 1024 bytes, or one that is not byte for byte what assay writes (optionally followed by one newline), is refused, and the lease is then neither reaped nor taken over. Unknown fields are rejected.

expires_at.description: After this instant the lock may be reaped.

repository.description: A GitHub `owner/name`; the name is not `.` or `..`.

time.description: A UTC instant to the millisecond, `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ`.
